title: ChatGPT Playbook: Stop scattered systems. Do this instead.
caption:
Stop scattered systems. Do this instead.

Audit yourself against this:
1️⃣ Write a system prompt — Role, customer, tone, what to avoid — paste it every session. One-off asks give one-off quality.
2️⃣ Ask for 20 drafts — First output is a draft. Pick the pattern you like from the batch, then refine that one.
3️⃣ Keep repeat jobs — A 'caption rewriter' GPT holds the prompt so recurring work starts at 80%, not from zero.
4️⃣ Fact-check every number — Statistics and prices get invented confidently. Confirm before you publish — every time.
